summary.text: Dennis Hannon, a Republican and Conservative technology professional and first-time candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in New York's 26th Congressional District to Timothy Kennedy.
He launched his campaign in April 2026 and said his priorities were public safety, lowering costs and protecting children physically and online.

paragraphs.text: Hannon says he grew up working in his father's construction business, and he works as a technology professional. According to his Ballotpedia survey, he decided to run after becoming a parent and, in his words, fighting for his own child over medical decisions; he said he was running to put working families first.
He formally launched his campaign in April 2026 and advanced to the general election as the Republican and Conservative Party candidate without a primary.
He received 34.0% of the vote to Timothy Kennedy's 65.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
